    // The struck triangle of the first hit (-1 when the target is not a mesh).
    HitFace(self: IRaycast3D, query: RayQuery3D): FaceIndex
        => self.Raycast(query).Face;

    // The barycentric location of the first hit within its struck triangle.
    // Precondition: the query hits a mesh.
    HitBarycentric(self: IRaycast3D, query: RayQuery3D): BarycentricCoordinate
        => self.Raycast(query).Barycentric;

    // The interpolated surface UV at the first hit ((0, 0) when the target has no
    // UVs). Precondition: the query hits.
    HitUv(self: IRaycast3D, query: RayQuery3D): UvCoordinate
        => self.Raycast(query).Uv;

    //==
    // IClosestPoint2D — reports its closest point to a 2D query point.

    // The distance from `point` to the nearest point on this geometry.
    DistanceTo(self: IClosestPoint2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.ClosestPoint(point).Distance;

    // The position on this geometry nearest to `point`.
    ClosestPointPosition(self: IClosestPoint2D, point: Point2D): Point2D
        => self.ClosestPoint(point).Position;

    // True when `point` lies within `tolerance` of this geometry.
    IsNear(self: IClosestPoint2D, point: Point2D, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.DistanceTo(point) <= tolerance;

    //==
    // IClosestPoint3D — reports its closest point to a 3D query point.

    // The distance from `point` to the nearest point on this surface.
    DistanceTo(self: IClosestPoint3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.ClosestPoint(point).Distance;

    // The position on this surface nearest to `point`.
    ClosestPointPosition(self: IClosestPoint3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
        => self.ClosestPoint(point).Position;

    // True when `point` lies within `tolerance` of this surface.
    IsNear(self: IClosestPoint3D, point: Point3D, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.DistanceTo(point) <= tolerance;

    // INearestNeighbor2D — k-nearest-neighbor search over 2D points. The

    // A k-nearest request around `center` for `count` neighbors, distance-unbounded.
    NearestQuery(self: INearestNeighbor2D, center: Point2D, count: Integer): KNearestQuery2D
        => (center, count, 0.0);

    // The `count` nearest points to `center`, sorted ascending by distance.
    FindNearest(self: INearestNeighbor2D, center: Point2D, count: Integer): NearestNeighbors
        => self.FindNearest(self.NearestQuery(center, count));

    FindNearest(self: INearestNeighbor2D, center: Point2D): NearestNeighbors
        => self.FindNearest(center, 1);

    NearestQuery(self: INearestNeighbor3D, center: Point3D, count: Integer): KNearestQuery3D

    FindNearest(self: INearestNeighbor3D, center: Point3D, count: Integer): NearestNeighbors

    //==
    // # Hierarchy queries — BVHs, quadtrees and octrees
    //
    // The `ISpatialIndex2D` / `ISpatialIndex3D` obligations of the hierarchies in
    // `spatial-structures.types.plato`, and the `IRaycast3D` obligation of
    // `Bvh3D`.
    //
    // Every traversal is written as a recursion over node indices, because the depth
    // is a property of the data rather than of the type and this vocabulary has no
    // loop. The recursion is the whole benefit of the structure: a node whose bounds
    // miss the query prunes its entire subtree, so the cost is the size of the
    // answer plus the boundary of the query region, not the size of the index.
    //
    // The empty result is spelled `Take(0)` on the structure's own permutation
    // array. That is not a workaround for a missing empty-array literal so much as
    // the one spelling that fixes the element type without naming it.

    //==
    // # Bvh2D

    // The leaf-order permutation holds every primitive exactly once.
    ItemCount(self: Bvh2D): Integer
        => self.PrimitiveIndices.Count;

    // The primitives under `node` whose subtree meets the query bounds. A node
    // index of -1 contributes nothing.
    //
    // Written as an expression rather than with `var` bindings on purpose: a
    // `var` is evaluated whether or not the branch that reads it is taken, so
    // binding the recursive descent would defeat the very pruning the guard
    // exists for — and would not terminate on a node with one absent child. Every
    // traversal in this library has the same shape for the same reason.
    BvhCandidates(self: Bvh2D, bounds: Bounds2D, node: SpatialNodeIndex): Array<ItemIndex>
        => node.Value < 0
            ? self.PrimitiveIndices.Take(0)
            : self.BvhNodeCandidates(bounds, self.Nodes[node.Value]);

    // The primitives under one node, once it is known to exist.
    BvhNodeCandidates(self: Bvh2D, bounds: Bounds2D, n: BvhNode2D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => !n.Bounds.Overlaps(bounds)
            ? self.PrimitiveIndices.Take(0)
            : (n.LeftChild.Value < 0 && n.RightChild.Value < 0
                ? self.PrimitiveIndices.Slice(n.Primitives.Start, n.Primitives.End)
                : self.BvhCandidates(bounds, n.LeftChild)
                      .Concatenate(self.BvhCandidates(bounds, n.RightChild)));

    // Every primitive in a leaf whose bounds meet the query bounds, with false
    // positives: a leaf is reported whole.
    CandidatesInBounds(self: Bvh2D, bounds: Bounds2D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.Nodes.Count == 0
            ? self.PrimitiveIndices.Take(0)
            : self.BvhCandidates(bounds, SpatialNodeIndex(0));

    //==
    // # Bvh3D

    // The leaf-order permutation holds every primitive exactly once.
    ItemCount(self: Bvh3D): Integer
        => self.PrimitiveIndices.Count;

    // The primitives under `node` whose subtree meets the query bounds.
    BvhCandidates(self: Bvh3D, bounds: Bounds3D, node: SpatialNodeIndex): Array<ItemIndex>
        => node.Value < 0
            ? self.PrimitiveIndices.Take(0)
            : self.BvhNodeCandidates(bounds, self.Nodes[node.Value]);

    // The primitives under one node, once it is known to exist.
    BvhNodeCandidates(self: Bvh3D, bounds: Bounds3D, n: BvhNode3D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => !n.Bounds.Overlaps(bounds)
            ? self.PrimitiveIndices.Take(0)
            : (n.LeftChild.Value < 0 && n.RightChild.Value < 0
                ? self.PrimitiveIndices.Slice(n.Primitives.Start, n.Primitives.End)
                : self.BvhCandidates(bounds, n.LeftChild)
                      .Concatenate(self.BvhCandidates(bounds, n.RightChild)));

    // Every primitive in a leaf whose bounds meet the query bounds.
    CandidatesInBounds(self: Bvh3D, bounds: Bounds3D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.Nodes.Count == 0
            ? self.PrimitiveIndices.Take(0)
            : self.BvhCandidates(bounds, SpatialNodeIndex(0));
